judged_text: This spec asserts that the controller invokes TopicRetriever synchronously (`TopicRetriever.expects(:new)` / `retriever.expects(:retrieve)`), but the controller only enqueues the async Jobs::RetrieveTopic Sidekiq job (embed_controller.rb line 15), which never executes in-process in the test environment. The mocha expectations are never satisfied and the example fails with an unsatisfied-expectation error, leaving the diff's own suite red in CI and the controller→job→retriever wiring shipping with no passing test.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no `topic_id` is found it enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `loading`; it does not instantiate `TopicRetriever` or call `retrieve` synchronously. However, `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` explicitly sets `TopicRetriever.expects(:new)` and `retriever.expects(:retrieve)` in the no-embed case, so those expectations will not be met by the controller action shown in the diff, making the spec fail (red suite).
